raw.query:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT d.run_id,
         CASE WHEN d.run_id LIKE '%_aic_s%' THEN 'aic' ELSE 'polynomial' END AS timing_model,
         (regexp_match(d.run_id, '_s([0-9]+)$'))[1]::int AS sweep_step,
         CASE WHEN d.run_id LIKE 'sweeps:llm_head2k_%' THEN 'steady' ELSE 'burst' END AS population
  FROM provenance.v_dim d
  WHERE d.is_current = true
    AND d.run_id ~ '^sweeps:llm_(head2k|burst1)_(aic|poly)_s[0-9]+$'
), infractions AS (
  SELECT d.population, d.timing_model, d.sweep_step,
         bool_or(i.is_violation) AS verdict_is_violation,
         jsonb_object_agg(i.sla_metric, jsonb_build_object('p99_ms', i.achieved_p99_ms, 'bound_ms', i.bound_ms, 'violation', i.is_violation) ORDER BY i.sla_metric) AS metrics
  FROM d
  JOIN provenance.v_infraction i ON i.run_id = d.run_id AND i.is_current = true
  GROUP BY d.population, d.timing_model, d.sweep_step
), denominators AS (
  SELECT d.population, d.timing_model, d.sweep_step, max(p.n_requests) AS n_requests
  FROM d
  JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency p ON p.run_id = d.run_id AND p.is_current = true
  GROUP BY d.population, d.timing_model, d.sweep_step
), steady AS (
  SELECT timing_model, min(sweep_step) FILTER (WHERE verdict_is_violation) AS first_violating_step
  FROM infractions
  WHERE population = 'steady'
  GROUP BY timing_model
), burst AS (
  SELECT i.timing_model, i.verdict_is_violation, i.metrics, d.n_requests
  FROM infractions i
  JOIN denominators d USING (population, timing_model, sweep_step)
  WHERE i.population = 'burst' AND i.sweep_step = 1
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'steady_first_violating_step', (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(timing_model, first_violating_step) FROM steady),
  'steady_step_difference', (SELECT max(first_violating_step) - min(first_violating_step) FROM steady),
  'burst_s1', (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(timing_model, jsonb_build_object('any_sla_violation', verdict_is_violation, 'n_requests', n_requests, 'metrics', metrics)) FROM burst)
) AS observed
